card.name: Linking words before vessels and equipment
card.fires_on: Small linking words, brackets or commas just before a noun for a ship, vehicle, machine or physical object, mostly in general web text. It also fires on ship prefixes like HMS.

modes.label: Ships and vessels
modes.description: Words like aboard or HMS, or a comma, just before a named ship or research vessel.
modes.example: on his infamous voyage of 1787 aboard<< HMS>> Bounty.

modes.label: Mechanical parts and equipment
modes.description: Words like of, on or a before the name of a machine part or piece of equipment.
modes.example: as would be found on<< a>> chain sprocket, spur gear,

modes.label: Opening bracket before a gloss
modes.description: An opening bracket right after a plural noun, before its explanation.
modes.example: lulavim (palm branches), etrogim<< (>>citrons), and incense holders.

card.writes: It seems to push toward nouns about construction, buildings and structures, and away from installation and equipment words.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words right before a ship, machine or object is named.
